# Third-Party Attributions

### Purpose
Human-readable attribution list for OSS components displayed/distributed by LIFESYNC.

### Entry template
```text
Component:
Repository:
Version/Commit:
License:
Used for:
Modifications:
Attribution text:
License file retained at:
```

### Governance
This file is generated/updated as dependencies are introduced. The implementation MUST NOT invent attribution wording; copy required notices from the license/repository when required.
